description: List this tenant's recent runs, newest first, optionally filtered by tool, status (queued|running|done|error|timeout|cancelled), trigger (call|job|schedule|event|chain) or end_user_subject (the end user, if any, the run ran as).

end_user_subject.description: Only runs that ran as this end user's subject.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins. Omitting it on a connection with no header returns tenant_key_missing (-32602).

tool.description: Only runs of this tool name.

trigger.description: Only runs of this trigger kind.

name: host.runs.list
